issue_context.title: Problem with fans in lutron_caseta integration with latest beta
issue_context.body:
**The problem**

After installing the 2021.3 beta in order to get my garage door controller working with Z-Wave JS, I noticed that my Lutron Caseta fans were not working. I think it has something to do with the latest changes to the fan speed settings. Perhaps the new lutron_caseta integration needs to be updated as well?

**What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?**

core-2021.3.0b0

**What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?**

2021.2

**What type of installation are you running?**

Home Assistant OS

**Integration causing the issue**

lutron_caseta

**Link to integration documentation on our website**

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lutron_caseta/

**Example YAML snippet**

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line

```
